It lets AI agents work with RHOAI resources (projects, workbenches, KServe InferenceServices, pipelines, storage, training) by calling the Kubernetes API. It ships as a container image (Containerfile and Dockerfile.konflux, which expose port 8000 with a /health check, plus an ENTRYPOINT that runs rhoai-mcp over stdio, SSE or streamable-http transports). It is deployed to OpenShift with the kustomize manifests in deploy/kustomize, which have base and overlays. It does have a pluggy-based plugin system and can be installed as a Python package, but its main purpose is to run as a long-lived server process, so it is a service rather than a library.
